::: {#rem-linear-code-weight}
#### The minimum distance of a linear code is its smallest nonzero weight

For codewords $c \ne c'$ of a [linear code](#def-linear-code),
$\hamdist{c}{c'}$ is the [weight](#def-weight) of $c - c'$,
which is itself a nonzero codeword.
So the minimum distance is the smallest weight of a nonzero codeword.

:::
